definitions.explanation: Projectiles, cartridges, shells, and other materials fired from weapons. Includes bullets, shells, grenades, and similar ordnance.

examples.japanese: {弾薬|だんやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きた→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧。
{弾薬|だんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弾薬|だんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生死|せいし}→生死：05565_seishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the battlefield, ammunition management determines whether soldiers live or die.

notes:
Composed of {弾|だん} (bullet/projectile) + {薬|やく} (here meaning gunpowder/explosive charge, not medicine). Covers all types of ammunition including bullets, shells, and explosive ordnance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾薬|だんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to resupply ammunition
- {弾薬|だんやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧: to run out of ammunition
- {弾薬庫|だんやくこ}: ammunition depot; magazine
- {弾薬|だんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧: ammunition stockpile
- {実弾|じつだん}: live ammunition (as opposed to blanks)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧: weapon — the broader category
- {銃弾|じゅうだん}: bullet (specifically for firearms)
- ⟦{砲弾|ほうだん}→砲弾：19172_houdan⟧: artillery shell
- {火薬|かやく}: gunpowder; explosive — the propellant component

USAGE:
Appears in military, historical, and news contexts. In video games, {弾薬|だんやく} or the shorter ⟦{弾|たま}→弾：28121_tama⟧ is commonly used for ammunition resources.
